deep_analysis:
Open book: 3 LONGs, all fresh and right-side so far — no enforced trigger fires this cycle (nothing up 2%+/5%+, nothing open 8h+, exposure 3L/0S).

- XPL #16325 (bb-squeeze+, opened 09:15, meta_rsi 65.3): the textbook entry. Momentum band (7d LONG 65+ is the only positive RSI band), signal lifetime 80% WR. Hold; manage at trail arm.
- DOGE #16323 (continuation+, 1.1h, meta_rsi 28.6): entry was below-45 band but coin was, and is, moving with BTC (+0.34%/1h) — right side, bounce proving. High so far +0.34% vs +0.40% trail arm. Deadline stands: if trail not armed by 10:15 UTC (2h), exit flat rather than ride the -0.86% SL.
- GOAT #16324 (bb-bounce-v2-long+, 0.4h, meta_rsi 53.0): weakest thesis of the three — mid-band 45-55 entry (7d worst band), NEUTRAL 16m regime (conf 51, slope -0.019), ATR 0.12%/h which is the same stall shape that produced all 4 pump-chain+ trail_arm_timeout losses. If not +0.40% by 10:52 UTC (2h), exit flat.
- Correlation: all 3 are long-beta and move with BTC (+0.53%/1h). One BTC dump hits all three; combined SL risk is roughly -0.9% per position. Acceptable at 3/6 slots, do not add more alt LONGs until at least one trail arms.
- Opportunity cost is real but slot-limited: rotation leaders KAS +1.36%/1h, XRP/MNT/WLFI long-bias ripping while we hold flat GOAT. AI trader pick not fired — AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False (CEO 2026-10-19).
- The closed book is where we're bleeding: 26 closed in 24h, 7W (27%), -0.14 USDT. Losses are small and well-cut (machinery works); the problem is entry selection — 70% of entries never had follow-through.
regime_context:
BTC 1m continuum (09:14 UTC): price 83454 vs ema300 83021 — ABOVE for 209 consecutive minutes (last cross 05:29 UTC), zscore +1.95 STRONG_POS, linreg alignment 0.75 with 1m/5m/15m/1h all positive (LEAN_BULL), trend_quality STRONG_UP, state_score 99.5. BTC +0.53%/1h, +0.82%/2h. Volatility and volume both LOW — a quiet markup.

But the alt tape flipped hard: regime_5m 09:15 = 9 LONG_BIAS / 63 SHORT_BIAS / 52 neutral (overall SHORT_BIAS), vs 101/3 LONG at 08:00 — the largest intra-session flip observed. Disaggregation shows this is ROTATION, not a blanket alt dump: yesterday's runners are bleeding (OP -1.20%/1h, ALT -0.61%, FIL -0.41%, plus MET/APT/PONS/SAGA all SHORT_BIAS conf 87-93) while majors and new leaders bid (KAS +1.36%/1h, XRP/MNT/WLFI LONG_BIAS conf 56-92, DOGE/GOAT/XPL still +0.3-0.9%/1h). Note watchdog regime_summary disagrees with itself: btc_15m SHORT_BIAS vs btc_4h LONG_BIAS vs 1m STRONG_UP — intraday clocks are not aligned; treat the 1m continuum + 5m tape as live truth.

What it means for positions: our 3 alt LONGs are on the rotating-up side for now — direction is not the problem. New SHORTs are only valid on coins with their own SHORT_BIAS regime (the template that produced the sole 24h short win, ALT); shorting BTC or majors while BTC sits 209min above ema300 is fading the leader and loses. New LONGs should come from the rotation (KAS/XRP/MNT/WLFI class), not yesterday's dumping runners.
pattern_alerts:
All figures re-run in PostgreSQL this session, 2026-10-21 ~09:20 UTC. meta_rsi = _signal_metadata->>'rsi_14' (never entry_rsi_14).

PATTERN 1 — COUNTER-TREND SHORTS STILL THE BLEED (24h, n=9 verified): SHORT 9T/1W/-0.41 vs LONG 17T/6W/+0.27. The 8 losers (BTC x2, CRV, COMP x2, FOGO, ADA, IO) all closed against via atr_sl_hit/hard_sl. THE WINNING SIDE: short only what is dumping on its own — ALT won (+0.20, trail_sl) because its own regime was SHORT_BIAS conf 95 and it sits at the bottom of the 15m momentum table (16.8). Why the others lost: BTC is 209 min ABOVE ema300 with zscore +1.95 — every BTC short faded the leader directly, and pump-chain-/ai-trader-pending keep firing shorts on any red coin regardless of the BTC tape. Rule: shorts only on own-regime coins, never BTC/majors while BTC > ema300.

PATTERN 2 — MID-BAND ENTRIES NEVER ARM THE TRAIL (24h, n=4, identical): pump-chain+ LONG CFX -0.10 (meta_rsi 57.1), BLUR -0.02 (53.3), APT -0.04 (52.8), AIXBT 0.00 (50.0) — all exit=trail_arm_timeout, all entered RSI 50-57, none ever reached +0.40%. THE WINNING SIDE in the same window: momentum-band entries — ZRO r2v2-long5 RSI 74.5 hard_tp +3.33%, HYPE bb-squeeze+ RSI 65.6 trail +2.52%, BTC continuum-trend RSI 50 trail +0.36 (trend signal, not bounce). Same direction, different entry quality: follow-through at entry is what arms the trail; mid-band bounces in LOW volatility stall and timeout. Flag pump-chain+ mid-band config to brain auditor (parameter territory, not mine).

PATTERN 3 — WHERE THE LOSERS SIT (24h, n=19 with meta_rsi): losing entries avg meta_rsi 54.2 (LONG losers 55.0, SHORT losers 52.5) — the 45-55 dead zone confirmed again. Winners entered 65.6 / 74.5 / 59.7 / 50.0 (trend signals exempt). Why we weren't on the winning side: mid-band is where the confluence gates are easiest to pass, so the stream keeps feeding it.

PATTERN 4 — LOSS MACHINERY IS FINE, SELECTION IS NOT (last 20: 6W/14L, +0.02 total): every loss is small (-0.09% to -1.53% of position, cut by ATR SL / hard stops / cut_loser), winners bigger (+0.36% to +3.33%). We are break-even at 30% WR because wins are sized correctly — the entire deficit is the 70% of entries that were wrong-side or no-follow-through at open. Fix is entry quality (momentum band + trending coin + own-regime alignment), not wider stops, not new filters, not direction flipping.
